page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes stand in the right margin (letters a to i and the long note beside the first lines of the second paragraph). No left margin text, no headings, no text below the main column.

main_text.p: cessam ; sequitur ex communi sententia Papistarum, nullius Sancti animam adhuc videre Deum: nisi quem eorum negabunt contineri fidelium defunctorum numero, & {a}cum Luc. 12.46. {b}infidis Matt.24.51. hypo-critisque sociabunt. Porro preces istæ, quas pro fidelibus omnibus defunctis atque in Christo quiescentibus funduntur, fundendæ sunt in Missa usque ad diem iudicij, ex decreto {c}Papæ. Pij V. Bulla Missali suo ni-hilunqnam ad-dendum, detra-hendum, aut immutandum. Itaque nullius omnino Sancti animam Deum ante diem iudicij visuram esse pronuntiat cum Papistis suis Bellarminus.

8 Quid, quòd Papa Iohannes Vicesimus secundus, Bellarmino etiam fatente, in hoc erro-re fuit. Id enim perhiberi tradit {d}Adrianus, Pontifex Romanus, (etsi nondum Pontifex, opinor, quum hæc scripsit, affirmans certum esse Pontificem Romanum errare posse in fide, quoniam alij aliis in rebus erraverunt, in hac Ioannes iste. Et In 4. Sent. de sacram. confirmat. art. ult. {e}Gerson, Cancellarius Parisiensis Academiæ, postquàm, in sermone coram proceribus regni Galliæ habito, dixisset {f}latronem, qui verisimiliter non-dum compleverat pœnitentiam pro omnibus peccatis suis, beatificatum fuisse in paradiso ipsa hora mortis: Propter quod, inquit, apparet falsitas doctrinæ Papæ Iohannis Vicesimi secundi, quæ damnata fuit cum sono buccinarum vel tubarum coram rege Philippo avunculo tuo per theologos Parisienses de visione beata; & credidit potius theologis Parisiensibus quam Curiæ. {g}Bellarminus verò, quamquam cavillatur licuisse tempore Iohannis hoc sentire sine periculo hæresis? quorsum? quum, ut {h}hæresis includit pertinaciam, hodie quoque li-ceat, ut autem {i}errorem orthodoxæ fidei repug-

page.notes: Marginal notes, in order of their marks: a Luc. 12.46.; b Matt.24.51.; c Pij V. Bulla (Missali suo nihil unquam addendum, detrahendum, aut immutandum); d In 4. Sent. de sacram. confirmat. art. ult.; e Serm. in fest. Pasch. tom. 4.; f Luc. 23.43.; g De Rom. Pont. lib. 4. cap. 14.; h Hieron. in epist. ad Tit. cap. 3.; i Epiphan. adverf. hær. ref. The first note's reading "hilunqnam" is doubtful (perhaps "hilunquam") and is marked as printed. Reference letters d, e, f, g, h, i stand in the text as small marks; their notes are in the right margin and are given at the mark in the body. The marginal references a and b are the ones of the first paragraph. Some pieces of the margin lines were hard to separate and the hyphenation in the notes is as printed. The text's long s has been rendered as plain s throughout.
